selected_observations.excerpt:
Counterparty: Northbridge Analytics, Inc.
Effective: 4 June 2021
Term: 24 months. The agreement auto-renews for successive 12-month periods unless either party gives 90 days' written notice before the then-current term ends.

Northbridge: sales uses the short name "Northbridge Analytics". Billing and the MSA use "Northbridge Analytics Inc." A 2024 credit check also returned a Wyoming LLC, "Northbridge Analytics LLC". Legal has not determined which registry entity is the contracting party. Treat that registry link as unresolved.

selection_rationale: Governing-contract judgment for INV-2001 and MSA-NBA-2021 uses the invoice billed_name, the named contract counterparty, and any explicit commercial-notes statement tying invoices to that agreement.
known_missing_information: world.sqlite is not present in workspace; compiled identity_judgment tuples from prior passes cannot be queried via TaskView.
No invoice-level contract reference field in billing source; governing contract must be inferred from counterparty name chain or commercial notes.
Northbridge registry entity ambiguity may block confident contract linkage if identity to MSA counterparty is unresolved.
